settings.deleteHint: Final: your account and your answers are erased right away.

delete.title: Delete your account?
delete.intro: This is final, and we won't be able to recover anything:
delete.point1: your account, your sessions and all your answers are erased;
delete.point2: the titles you added stay in your groups, signed “former member”;
delete.point3: in groups you own, ownership passes to the longest-standing member;
delete.point4: groups where you're the only member are deleted along with their list.
delete.exportFirst: Remember to download your data first.
delete.reauth: For your security, sign in again with Google, then start the deletion again.

settings.deleted: Your account has been deleted. The couch is still here if you come back.

about.title: About
about.what: Canapact is the watchlist for people who watch in pairs (or more). For each title, everyone says whether you can watch it without them. No more “you watched it without me?!”.
about.who: A small home-made app, no ads and no data selling, by someone who got tired of negotiating every episode.
about.youtube: Video titles, thumbnails and channels come from YouTube, via the YouTube API Services. Canapact is not affiliated with, or endorsed by, YouTube or Google.

donate.title: Buy Canapact a blanket
donate.pitch: Canapact is free and ad-free. If it saves you a few couch arguments, a small donation helps pay for the server (and the blanket).
donate.hint: Donations go through Liberapay: Canapact never sees or keeps any of it.
